one_sentence: The Cross structurally reverses all seven distinct attacks from Genesis 3 at the same levels, satisfying a symmetry requirement of repair.
executive_summary: This document argues that the seven adversary moves in Genesis 3—information distortion, boundary violation, self-exaltation, illicit knowledge, physical death, separation from God, and exile—are each exactly countered by seven distinct actions at the Cross: truth incarnation, voluntary boundary submission, kenosis, voluntary ignorance, physical death and resurrection, experienced Godforsakenness, and veil-tearing. The key structural claim is that each counter operates at the same level as its corresponding attack, fulfilling a symmetry requirement of repair. The conclusion is that the Cross uniquely addresses all seven dimensions of damage, making it the only event that structurally matches the Fall. Five kill conditions are provided to falsify the isomorphism.
short_summary: This document is a capstone article in the Genesis-to-Quantum series presenting a seven-pair structural isomorphism between attacks in Genesis 3 and counter-moves at the Cross. The core claim is that each counter operates at the same level as its corresponding attack, satisfying a symmetry requirement of repair. Key evidence includes seven level-matched pairs, the cherubim-on-veil correspondence, and the vector reversal in Philippians 2:6. This matters because it provides a falsifiable framework showing the Cross as the unique structural solution to the Fall.
